name: REST / JSON (service)
description: Non-placeable data source that GETs any public JSON HTTP(S) endpoint and hands the parsed response to a code element. The universal fallback when there's no bespoke service plugin for an API. Not shown in the canvas picker; source it by key 'rest_service'. Set options.url (and optional options.headers as a JSON object, e.g. an Authorization header). Loopback and private-network hosts are blocked. Probe with an empty url to see usage.

cell_options.name: headers
cell_options.label: Request headers
cell_options.help: Optional. A JSON object of extra request headers.
